T:P1.1.text: Roofing, Insulation, and Doors | Owens Corning

T:P1.2.text: Owens Corning is a branded building products leader with three complementary market-leading businesses providing roofing, insulation, and doors

T:P1.3.text: Owens Corning is building a sustainable future through material innovation.

T:P1.5.text: Owens Corning has published its 2025 Sustainability Report, Built To Sustain, outlining the company’s progress toward it’s 2030 sustainability goals.

T:P1.6.text: ‘Summer Harvest’ Introduced as 2027 Shingle Color of the Year

T:P1.7.text: The 2027 Shingle Color of the Year, Summer Harvest, captures the beauty of late summer as it gently transitions into autumn. More than just a color, this TruDefinition® Duration® Designer Shingle delivers trusted performance with our patented SureNail® Technology for lasting protection through every season.

T:P1.9.text: He has been appointed to serve on the Audit Committee and the Finance and Technology Committee.

T:P2.2.text: Our global nonwovens business is dedicated to transforming four key markets - construction, flooring, interiors, and industrial - with differentiated solut

T:P2.3.text: Our global nonwovens business is dedicated to transforming four key markets - construction, flooring, interiors, and industrial - with differentiated solutions that enable a world of possibilities for architects, builders, and designers.

T:P2.5.text: Compared to traditional ceiling materials, GLAS- POWERED™ ceiling facers & backers enable higher performance standards. Whether you're building for a brighter, quieter office space or a mold conscious healthcare facility, each veil request is tailor-made to fit your needs.

T:P2.6.text: Glas-Powered Facers for Insulated Roof Decks & Walls

T:P2.7.text: Compared to traditional materials like paper faced insulation boards, Owens Corning GLAS- POWERED™ facers enable higher performance standards. Whether you're building for a more durable exterior, to extend the life of your roof deck, or for a moisture resistant building envelope, Owens Corning Glass Coated Facers (GCF) for polyisocyanurate (polyiso) insulated roof decks & walls are tailor-made to fit your needs.

T:P2.8.text: Compared to traditional materials like paper faced gypsum board or OSB, Owens Corning GLAS- POWERED™ gypsum facers & backers enable higher performance standards. Designed to increase weatherability, mold & mildew resistance, impact resistance & dimensional stability.

T:P2.9.text: A sustainable future is the whole world’s business. Our products are designed with a sustainable impact in mind, and our nonwoven veils are no exception.

T:P2.10.text: They enable stronger, lighter, and more durable buildings, that are ready to meet the needs of a changing world.

T:P2.11.text: From technical information to regional availability, we're always ready to answer your questions.

C:S1.1.text: Simpson Manufacturing Co. operates mainly through its Simpson Strong-Tie brand, and the sources describe a broad line of connectors, fasteners, and anchors sold through retail and OEM channels.

C:S2.1.text: The company's products serve residential construction, industrial, commercial and infrastructure construction, remodeling and do-it-yourself markets.

C:S3.1.text: The Home Depot is described as its largest customer. Independent retailers carry the line through Ace Hardware, True Value, Do it Best, Orgill.

C:S4.1.text: One source lists anchors, angles, bases, caps, connectors, fasteners, and hangers, plus prefabricated shearwalls, powder-actuated tools, and adhesives.

C:S5.1.text: A company earnings call transcript says the company is selling fasteners and connectors and anchors into that national retail space and calls its OEM segment relatively new, been one of our faster-growing segments.
